notes.title: v1.1.2 (LOTS of changes)
notes.notes:
LOTS of changes and fixes with this one, including the overhaul to try and balance the Drachma system better.

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Drachmas are now earned on a multiplying scale after all upgrades have been unlocked.
[*]The 16 new stickers now actually have their unlock status save. (Can't BELIEVE I didn't catch that one earlier. ːsteamfacepalmː)
[*]Reset achievement values have been reduced from 1-10-25 to 1-5-10.
[*]Tooltip describing how Drachmas work appears when hovering over the reset button or large Drachma icons in the UI.
[/list]

[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Car and truck now have visible seats.
[*]Dolly cart and car wheels are more centered.
[*]The sun reflection now stays on the water layer in Asphodel theme.
[*]The click counter will now first appear after 100 total clicks.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.1
notes.notes:
Working on an overhaul to balance out the Drachma system again. In the meantime, here are some smaller fixes and tweaks.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Finally[/i] fixed the ground reset threshold!
[*]There is now a visual "click counter" in the bottom right of the main UI.
[*]Click count now saves progress.
[*]Speed cap on visuals now applies backwards as well.
[*]Values in the upgrade shop now round the same way your money in the main UI does.
[/list]

notes.title: Sticker Update! v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Finished this major update far sooner than expected! Decided to push it as soon as possible before I devote my weekend to playing Silksong lol.


[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]16 new stickers!
[*]Stickers now have rotation and scaling options!
[*]Added an "undo" button next to the "delete all" button in the sticker UI.
[*]The first 4 stickers are now free in the reset sticker unlocks menu.
[/list]

[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]The "undo" button in the sticker menu is now the only one with the dotted arrow icon. All closing menu buttons now say "back" or "return" to avoid confusion.
[*]Further tweaking of values for the ground reset threshold.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Roadmap / Future Plans
notes.notes: [p]Alrighty! Time to crack down on fixes and polishing for the next several weeks (potentially months).[/p][p][/p][p]First and foremost, I will be working on balancing and bug fixes. Bug fixes will be prioritized, though I don't believe there will be as many bugs as balance fixes. Currently, I am trying to pace out the Drachma earning, purchases and reset system so that it just [i]feels[/i] more satisfying, especially in the late game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Listed below is the rough roadmap for planned updates:[/b][/p][p][/p][h3] - *PATCHES/HOTFIXES/BALANCING* (Continuous throughout project)[/h3][p][/p][h3] - STICKER UPDATE[/h3][p]	- Sticker rotation and sizing[/p][p]	- Sticker selection and individual deleting[/p][p]	- 16 New stickers[/p][p][/p][h3] - BOULDER + THEME UPDATE[/h3][p]	- 6 New Boulders[/p][p]	- 3 New Themes[/p][p]	- 6 New Theme Colors[/p][p]	- Dust sliding effect[/p][p]	- Path rubble/clutter that actually clears[/p][p][/p][h3] - LOCALIZATION UPDATE[/h3][p]	- Spanish[/p][p]	- Russian[/p][p]	- German[/p][p]	- Chinese (Simplified)[/p][p]	- Japanese[/p][p][/p][h3] - SOUND UPDATE[/h3][p]	- Vehicle sounds[/p][p]	- Updated/Improved sounds[/p][p]	- Music and autosave labels fade away[/p][p][/p][h3] - (Potentially (Hopefully!)) LINUX AND STEAM DECK SUPPORT[/h3][p][/p][h3] - GOG RELEASE[/h3][p][/p][h3] - MOBILE PORT[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p]The order will likely be as listed, though it is very possible that any of these updates could be finished earlier or later than expected.[/p][p][/p][p][b]If anyone is able to provide localization support ([i]especially for any languages not listed[/i]), please reach out to me at [/b][url="https://sickbastardgames@gmail.com"]sickbastardgames@gmail.com[/url][b]![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who purchased the game and bigger thanks for everyone's patience as I continue to improve it. Fingers crossed, I should be able to finish this and start my next project before the end of the year.[/p][h3]-GC[/h3]
